question: What is the goddess's relationship to offerings and likenesses of sesame flowers?
premises: The goddess is excellent in receiving offerings of sesame flowers.
The goddess destroys the mere likeness of sesame flowers.
inference: The goddess values true sesame-flower offerings while surpassing their mere appearance.
uncertainties: tilapuṣpābhanāśinī could mean destroyer of sesame-flower radiance or destroyer of what resembles sesame flowers; reading follows legacy hint.
plain_english: She is supreme in receiving sesame-flower offerings and destroys the mere likeness of sesame flowers.
